verdict.rationale: Shipping as an importable, bundleable package is a fair question for a game engine, since some engines are distributed this way, so the axis applies. The evidence shows Unreal Engine is a C++ editor and toolchain compiled with Visual Studio/Xcode and packaged through cook/UAT. Its source is EULA/account-gated, and nothing shows it published to a package registry as an importable or tree-shakeable library. The old HTML5 export mention, editor plugins and the Fab asset marketplace are adjacent features that earn no credit here.
